verdict.rationale: The only in-product AI evidence is a single support-doc line, "Use AI to help write or edit content." That is AI writing assistance, not insights or suggestions drawn from the user's board data. The MCP server only connects Trello to external AI tools, so it does not deliver AI inside the product. Missing for 10: AI-generated insights or analysis of board and card data, proactive in-product suggestions, documentation of how the AI features work, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
